instruction.text: Schiebe die Passivbildungen und Beispiele zur richtigen Zeitform.

atoms.sound: have or. has been. plus past participle

atoms.b: He had been warned before he went there.

atoms.a: Das Great Barrier Reef wurde von der Reisegruppe erkundet.
Die Geschichte wurde erzählt, bevor sie wussten, dass sie falsch ist.

instruction.text: Welcher Satz steht im Passiv und im present perfect? Wähle ihn aus.
instruction.sound: Welcher Satz steht im Passiv und im <voice voiceLang='en' voice='m2'>present perfect</voice> Wähle ihn aus.

b: ++The bag has been packed for school.
The bag was packed for school.
She has been packing her bag for school.
The grandparents have been visiting us.

instruction.text: Welcher Satz steht im Passiv und past perfect? Wähle ihn aus.
instruction.sound: Welcher Satz steht im Passiv und <voice voiceLang='en' voice='f3'>past perfect</voice> Wähle ihn aus.

b: ++After the English exam had been cancelled, the friends met.
After the English exam was cancelled, the friends met.
The English exam will be cancelled, so the friends can meet.
++After the first-aid video had been watched, they practised applying a bandage.
After the first-aid video has been watched, they will practise applying a bandage.
After the first-aid video was watched, they practised applying a bandage.

atoms.b: The orange juice ((had_been_drunk)) before it went bad.
The sandwiches ((had_been_eaten)) before the lunch break ended.
The cue cards ((had_been_written)) by Gemma before she gave the presentation.
